name: Establishing — lamp, covered sheets
start_frame_hint: Wide of the bed from the doorway. Warm lamp. Both adults under the duvet, faces readable, room geography clear.
body_motion_notes: Shared breathing under the sheets. Almost no limb travel. A small weight shift toward the middle of the mattress.
negative_prompt: daylight, office, crowd, camera crew, text overlay
director_intent: Open the study on safety and place. Let the lamp do the work. Do not rush the cut in.
